authorization: User approved the first proposal: trim unused database property storage using Qt-native/C++17 tools.

change.mechanism: QVector::squeeze() on finished object property lists and unowned properties, after all interpretation and audio-summary decoding.

fullScan.measurementBoundary: Fresh process MediaScanner+Canon+formatted rows; before audit serialization, before MediaTableModel population; Debug, filesystem caches not cleared; tests/build/proof did not overlap the timed after scan.

sourceGraphProof.scope: Read-only temporary diagnostic; production and tests unchanged by diagnostic.
sourceGraphProof.build: Same Qt6.5.3 and C++17; before copied Canon Debug static library vs after current Canon Debug static library; diagnostic O2 arm64.
sourceGraphProof.hashMethod: QDataStream Qt_6_0 big-endian serialized all declared ParsedSource fields recursively, including source receipts, record sets, objects, properties, native contexts, decoded QVariants, locators/framing/ranges, ordered relationships and recorded references, diagnostics; full Projection files/masters/object references/observations/coverage and read/selected states. Streamed through 64KB SHA256 sink; QHash fields sorted; QT_HASH_SEED=0 both modes. Pointer addresses and capacities excluded.
sourceGraphProof.sourceStampMethod: Before each pair exact size, mtime nanoseconds, device/inode and absolute path; stamp rechecked after pair and unchanged for all90.
limitations: Same unchanged local source specimens, not a guarantee for every possible file.
Full-scan output/evidence scheduling equivalence measured separately by main task.
No pointer-sharing topology fingerprint; pointed-to receipt/context contents are serialized.
Timing supplementary only; main task tests/build ran concurrently.
Mac arm64 Debug library; no Windows/NEXIS benchmark.

independentReview.ownershipAndIndexLifetime: Compaction precedes projection; parser owns indices and copied locators, not pointers into property lists. Native contexts retain their QSharedPointer ownership. Each vector compacted separately.
independentReview.simplestApproach: Mirrors MXF reader. Exact reserve would add counting/index work and must account for decoded audio-summary fields; no custom allocation or new memory cap introduced.

limits: One comparable full-scan timing/memory pair; no statistically established speed gain.
Peak measured is resident memory; no sampled peak physical-footprint claim.
Mac arm64 native execution with universal Debug builds; Windows/NEXIS/Release behavior unmeasured.
Graph proof covers 90 unchanged genuine sources, excludes allocation capacity and pointer-sharing topology from semantic hashes.
Diagnostic program and runner are evidence artifacts, not app targets; runner retains temporary paths from the captured experiment.
